about: The lists and columns of the app as they were written by hand, in six places, before Phase 10c-2b gave them one file. A record: never regenerated. See scripts/schema-snapshot.js.

public/js/dataService.js.spBaseSpec: const spBaseSpec = (list, column) => column === 'AppId' ? { column, expect: 'Text', indexed: true, unique: true, strict: true } : { column, expect: Object.keys(spBaseTypes).find((type) => spBaseTypes[type].includes(column)) ?? 'Text', strict: Object.entries(spLists[list][1]).some(([key, name]) => name === column && spArrays.has(key)), };
